semiconductor_relevance: High — CKD KOREA CO., LTD. provides essential components and technologies for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CKD KOREA CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing and supplying critical components for semiconductor production, including various types of valves and manifolds. Their offerings are designed to enhance manufacturing efficiency and are used in both semiconductor and secondary battery manufacturing applications.

regional_presence.Japan: CKD KOREA CO., LTD. supplies critical components to semiconductor manufacturers in Japan.
